items.briefing:
Australia and New Zealand are experiencing a surge in critical software vulnerabilities, and organisations running VMware vCenter should be aware of an active global attack campaign targeting a serious flaw in that platform — patch it immediately if you haven't already. At the same time, AI-powered cybercrime is increasing rapidly in scale, making attacks faster and harder to detect, while ransomware groups continue operating at record numbers even as overall victim counts have stabilised.

Locally, these threats are real and growing. Ensure your IT team is applying security patches promptly and that staff remain cautious with unexpected emails or messages.

**Tip:** Ask your IT team to confirm that VMware systems and any critical software are fully up to date today.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Patch backlogs leaving Australian organisations critically exposed to 85 high-impact security flaws.
